title: Digestion & Absorption of Lipids
objectives: Understand the sequential process of lipid digestion in GI tract
Identify key enzymes and cofactors involved in lipid breakdown
Explain micelle formation and lipid absorption mechanisms
Recognize clinical conditions causing lipid malabsorption

digestion.title: Lipid Digestion Process
digestion.content:
Lipid Digestion Sites

Stomach

Enzymes: Lingual/gastric lipases (pH 2-4)

Action: Hydrolyze sn-3 bonds of TAGs → 1,2-DAGs + FAs

Specificity: Short/medium-chain FAs

Small Intestine

Hormones: Secretin (bicarbonate) & CCK (bile/enzyme release)

Key Actions: Neutralizes pH, stimulates gallbladder contraction

enzymes.title: Key Enzymes
enzymes.content:
Pancreatic Enzymes

Pancreatic Lipase

Action: Cleaves sn-1 & sn-3 TAGs → 2-MAGs + FAs

Cofactor: Colipase (anchors to lipid interface)

Inhibitor: Orlistat (anti-obesity drug)

Phospholipase A2

Action: Cleaves sn-2 PLs → Lysophospholipids

Activation: Requires trypsin & bile salts

Cholesterol Esterase

Action: Hydrolyzes cholesterol esters → Cholesterol + FAs

absorption.title: Absorption Mechanisms
absorption.content:
Micelle Formation

Bile salts emulsify lipids into 1μm disc-shaped micelles containing MAGs, FAs, cholesterol, and fat-soluble vitamins.

Enterocyte Processing

Resynthesis: ER converts 2-MAGs → TAGs via acyltransferases

Packaging: TAGs + cholesterol + apolipoproteins → Chylomicrons

Transport: SCFAs/MCFAs → portal vein; LCFAs → lymphatics

clinical.title: Clinical Correlations
clinical.content:
Lipid Malabsorption

Cystic Fibrosis

Pathology: CFTR defect → thickened pancreatic secretions

Manifestations:

  • Steatorrhea (fatty stools)
  • COPD, pancreatic insufficiency
  • Male infertility

Treatment: Enzyme supplements + MCFAs

Short Bowel Syndrome

Cause: Reduced absorptive surface

Management: Low-fat diet with MCFA supplementation

faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.content:
Frequently Asked Questions

Why are bile salts essential for lipid absorption?
They emulsify large fat droplets into micelles, increasing surface area for pancreatic enzymes and enabling transport of hydrophobic products to enterocytes.
How does orlistat cause weight loss?
It irreversibly inhibits gastric/pancreatic lipases, preventing ~30% of dietary fat absorption, leading to calorie deficit.
Why are MCFAs recommended for malabsorption?
They're absorbed directly into portal blood (unlike LCFAs needing chylomicrons) and don't require bile for solubilization.
